evals.prompt: A narrow mobile toolbar needs two text-only visual directions. Keep the existing navy palette, labels Save and Cancel, and no new actions. Describe hierarchy and layout tradeoffs in 120 words; no tools.
evals.expected_output: A scoped, evidence-grounded response satisfying the listed expectations.
expectations: Exactly two directions, not a compulsory three.
